name: Local collaboration views
summary: Show who a process talks to on one installation, derived from the deployed definitions and the event log rather than drawn in one BPMN file: the interaction graph, an Operations view with every process collapsed and a replay of only the messages, an optional saved collaboration with its findings, and composing one step by step in the Modeler. Documentation and operational view only, no contract and no engine change.
next_action: Review and merge the LCV1 pull request (the interaction graph route, its MCP tool and the acceptance of ADR-0559); then start LCV2, the Operations view over that route with collapsed participants and the message-only replay read page by page from the event log.

slices.title: Interaction graph around one process (possible and observed)
slices.note: GET /api/v1/process-interactions and atlas_process_interactions: participants, exchanges with their possible and observed layers, sends that reached nobody, the process's message ports. Pure computation in api/interaction; the event-log scan runs off the loop on a ReadView, bounded at 100000 rows, and rows are read under the event log's own rule (eventLogReach). ADR-0559 accepted with this slice.

slices.title: Operations view: collapsed participants and the message-only replay
slices.note: ADR-0559 §7 and §8: the graph around a process in the Operations app, opening collapsed, each participant expandable; a replay of deliveries, starts, sends that reached nobody and black-box sends read from the event log page by page over a time range, with a dense mode that pulses counts; 'outside your view' for what the reader may not see; the history's beginning stated. Needs a time-ordered row route or cursor over the graph's rows, and browser end-to-end tests.

slices.title: Saved collaboration and its findings
slices.note: ADR-0559 §5: a design-time BPMN document of one collaboration, filed under an application, exported with it and never deployed; participants by atlas:processRef, flows by messageRef; the findings collaboration.participant-unresolved, flow-not-sent, flow-not-received, flow-not-observed, undrawn-exchange and reaches-outside. Decide the store first: a draft kind (editor, co-editing, history) or a store of its own.

slices.title: Composing a collaboration step by step in the Modeler
slices.note: ADR-0559 §6: ports at the pool edge from the graph's ports, a '+' listing the counterparts with their observed counts, name proposals separate from the binding, placeholders for unreceived names, a participant the reader may not see greyed and anonymous, drift reported with the edit that resolves it.
